change: Rerun E010's plain 2D U-Net on the recovered four-organ, HU-windowed dataset. The U-Net architecture, CE loss, optimizer, batch size, seed, one-slice input, and disabled augmentation remain E010's. The dataset changes to SEGTHOR_aorta_huwide and the maximum epoch budget changes from 25 to 75; early stopping remains disabled.
hypothesis: The E010 U-Net architecture should remain viable when the aorta is represented as its own target class. This run establishes four-organ performance under the recovered-label protocol; it is not a single-variable comparison with either E010 or E017.
plan_reference: E010 model-capacity rerun on the recovered-aorta data protocol introduced by E017

dataset.name: SEGTHOR_aorta_huwide
dataset.source: segthor_part1 (GT class 1 split back into esophagus + aorta)
dataset.label_caveat: Derived, not annotated: retrieve_aorta.py splits class 1. Patient_07 is checked against GT2; other patients pass geometric gates and visual review.

what_to_check: Confirm all classes 0 through 4 are present with check_labels.py before training.
With patience -1, the run must complete all 75 epochs unless the job fails.
Compute 3D Dice, IoU, HD95, ASSD, and NSD on the five validation patients using recovered GT.
Do not compare esophagus Dice directly with E010: its class 1 is esophagus plus aorta, while this target is the thin esophagus alone.
Interpret comparison with E017 as descriptive only: E017 uses ENet and 25 epochs, while this run changes architecture and budget.
